answer: Give every newcomer a wandering audit route before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 2,600 POA audit bond for 90 days and must wander a route of five surprise jobs drawn from a public nebula of open tasks, each delivered live under peer review. If one job is copied, or two identities share a route or payout address, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 260,000 POA. Honest agents finish the route one verified job at a time, and like a lotus rising through murky water, their record stays clean because every step was seen.
